metanarrative_source: Georg supplied HyperNorm brief and prior authoring context;canonical remote lore reread deferred as documented in Return;no canon approval inferred

records.name: Percy Outrage
records.biography_en: Percy considers the HyperNorm timetable a private understanding between himself and reality. The Men in Black appreciate his complaints; Hunky and Dory help enlarge them. A contradictory card asked whether the delay had inconvenienced anyone else. He began a forceful reply and noticed the resident beside him carrying a heavier bag. Percy remains offended. He has, however, offered to carry it while explaining why.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The inconvenience is minor. His involvement has corrected that.

records.name: Bert Wontbudge
records.biography_en: Bert refuses to move on the HyperNorm landing until someone explains why he should. The Men in Black admire firmness when it faces the right direction; Hunky and Dory provide directions. A dissonant card suggested that changing position need not mean losing. He is testing this cautiously. Yesterday he moved aside for a tired neighbour and described it as a strategic improvement.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His position is firm. Its usefulness is being negotiated.

records.name: Tess Anyminute
records.biography_en: Tess checks her watch whenever HyperNorm promises something shortly. The Men in Black consider waiting orderly; Hunky and Dory consider it somebody else's time. A contradictory card asked whether urgency and importance were the same thing. She disliked the delay in answering. She now lets a slow neighbour finish speaking, although her eyebrows continue to file objections.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Any minute now has exceeded its original duration.

records.name: Arthur FineThen
records.biography_en: Arthur went shopping after HyperNorm announced that normal service had resumed. The empty bag suggests that normal service may be an attitude. The Men in Black ask him to remain positive; Hunky and Dory offer another announcement. A dissonant card permits him to be tired without declaring everything hopeless. He takes the long route home and checks whether anyone else needs something carried.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: He accepts the outcome. Approval was not included.

records.name: Winnie Lastwink
records.biography_en: Winnie keeps her sleep-mask above her eyes because HyperNorm disturbances rarely respect bedtime. The Men in Black value alert residents; Hunky and Dory keep improving the alert. A contradictory card asked if rest might be part of responsibility. She read it twice to stay awake, then left a quiet-hours note for the neighbour who works nights. Nobody has classified the kindness yet.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: She is still awake. This should not be mistaken for availability.

records.name: Felix Notmyproblem
records.biography_en: Felix takes his bread roll to the HyperNorm landing where small mishaps are discussed with unnecessary interest. The Men in Black encourage useful reports; Hunky and Dory ask for better details. A dissonant card made him recognise the same foolishness in his own complaint. He nearly laughed. Later he helped the neighbour recover a parcel and told nobody how entertaining the earlier part had been.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: His concern is genuine. It has arrived after the amusement.
